explication: DuckDB is an embedded analytical database. Its principal workflow is submitting SQL through a client context, planning and executing queries, and returning results; SQL can also read CSV and Parquet files directly. The graph includes catalog and persistent-storage responsibilities plus documented SQL capabilities and JSON/Parquet extensions. Source excerpts are incomplete, so edges are limited to README statements and visible source references; unsampled extension internals are represented at their existing directories.
